title: Bela Devi v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip Gupta and Neeraj Tiwari, JJ.
disposition: Writ dismissed; petitioner relegated to Clause 6.5.
headnote: A writ disputing electricity issued by Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited is not entertained when Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 supplies a statutory alternative remedy; the petition is dismissed.
facts: Bela Devi filed Writ-C No. 11468 of 2018 in the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and three others. She disputed the electricity issued by Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited, Allahabad. Counsel for the respondents appeared and stated that she could invoke Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Division Bench of Dilip Gupta and Neeraj Tiwari, JJ. heard the petition on 2 April 2018.

holding_units.holding: Where a consumer disputes electricity issued by the distribution licensee, Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is a statutory alternative remedy, and a writ petition on that dispute will not be entertained.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the electricity issued by Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited
not_decided.note: The Court declined the writ on alternative-remedy grounds and did not examine the underlying dispute.
